sources.summary: Berlin studio Kéré Architecture has added a weathered steel-clad kindergarten to the Technical University of Munich campus in Germany, complete with a three-storey playground. Named Kinderoase an der TUM, the kindergarten is an on-site childcare facility to support young professionals, particularly women, at the university in balancing work and family responsibilities.
